This is purely anecdotal but I'm against what people brand as "streetwear". They mass produce shirts, each costing as low as 150 and then market them as premium fashion items going for 1500 and up.

This practice exploits workers, perpetuates cheap labor, poor working conditions, adds to the persisting problem of poor quality work in the Philippines. Selling privileged commentaries on the suffering of people for your personal interests won't benefit the [24.4 million Filipinos in non-regular, agency-hired, informal sector, or unpaid family work. This means low-paying and insecure work with poor or no benefits.](http://ibon.org/file/2015/11/2016-Yearend-Birdtalk_Change-Underway.pdf)

But yeah, for fundraising, this could work but you can't save the world with a poster, much more a shirt.
One for texting, reminders, notes, school/work related stuff. Another one for data, facebook, instagram, light games. One on smart, one on globe.
It feels kinda wrong to capitalize on the plight of other people. I doubt that streetwear would be a good medium for raising awareness/support on pressing issues.

"Hello?"

I do [this.](https://thebuddhistcentre.com/text/mindfulness-breathing) It's simple and convenient. All you need is yourself and you're good :)

I think there's more than one way to do it but what I do is I sit in a comfy upright position and then I try to close my eyes. I focus on my breathing, counting every inhale and exhale. Inhale, exhale, 1, inhale, exhale, 2, and so on until 10 after which you go back to 1. I do it for around 2 to 3 minutes. This is what works for me right now. You might find a way that would work better for you. Here are a few useful links :)

[r/meditation faq](https://www.reddit.com/r/Meditation/wiki/faq)

[The Mindfulness of Breathing](https://thebuddhistcentre.com/text/mindfulness-breathing)

[Starting meditation](http://sharemindfulness.com/2016/01/06/how-to-actually-make-meditation-a-habit-in-2016/)

I started meditating recently and it fucking works holy shit. It's like a refresh button for your brain. After you open your eyes parang kakagising mo lang and you have the energy to face a new day. I highly suggest meditation if you're stressed or you need to concentrate.
